scientificMetadata.label: Topology-Aware Composite
scientificMetadata.description: Synthetic terrain-aware composite with open-water, shoreline, channel, bay, and island-adjacent behaviors.
scientificMetadata.equation: F(x,y,t) = sum_r w_r(mask(x,y),t) behavior_r(x,y,t), then boundary-adjusted
scientificMetadata.inWords: The terrain mask changes which synthetic behavior is emphasized, and boundary handling reduces or deflects into-land flow.
scientificMetadata.expectedDiagnostics: Flow masked or reduced over land, visible channel/shoreline effects, bounded speed, and no meaningful arrows over land.
scientificMetadata.recommendedUse: Teaching qualitative topology effects, current risk near land, and planner-facing terrain-aware currents.
scientificMetadata.notA: CFD, ROMS, HYCOM, Delft3D, Navier-Stokes, or calibrated coastal hydrodynamics.
